title: Buffer Management
description: Copy code from multiple files into the current file using buffer commands.
tips:
1. Open file: ':o parser_utils.py'.
2. Select function: Use 'map' or 'maf' to select paragraph.
3. Yank: 'y'.
4. go to previous buffer: ':previous-buffer'.
5. Paste: 'p'.
6. Repeat for config_loader.py.
